import pandas as pd

""")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Query hourly visibility from Chek Lap Kok weather station (id=7) and PM2.5 from Tung Chung (id=6)
# for October 2025 (2025-10-01 00:00 to 2025-11-01 00:00)
query = text("""
SELECT 
    hsw.datetime,
    hsw.visibility,
    hsaq.pm2_5
FROM hourly_station_weather hsw
JOIN hourly_station_air_quality hsaq 
    ON hsaq.datetime = hsw.datetime AND hsaq.station_id = 6
WHERE hsw.station_id = 7
  AND hsw.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsw.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsw.visibility IS NOT NULL
  AND hsaq.pm2_5 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY hsw.datetime
""")
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Total matched hourly records: {len(df)}")
print(f"First few rows:")
print(df.head(10))
print(f"\nBasic stats:")
print(df[['visibility', 'pm2_5']].describe())

# Compute Pearson correlation
corr, p_value = stats.pearsonr(df['visibility'], df['pm2_5'])
vis_pm25_corr = round(corr, 4)
print(f"\nPearson correlation between visibility and PM2.5: {vis_pm25_corr}")
print(f"P-value: {p_value}")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query daily average visibility and PM2.5 for October 2025
query = text("""
SELECT 
    DATE(hsw.datetime) as date,
    AVG(hsw.visibility) as avg_visibility,
    AVG(hsaq.pm2_5) as avg_pm25
FROM hourly_station_weather hsw
JOIN hourly_station_air_quality hsaq 
    ON hsaq.datetime = hsw.datetime AND hsaq.station_id = 6
WHERE hsw.station_id = 7
  AND hsw.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsw.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsw.visibility IS NOT NULL
  AND hsaq.pm2_5 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE(hsw.datetime)
ORDER BY date
""")
daily_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Daily averages:")
print(daily_df.to_string(index=False))

# Find lowest and highest visibility days
low_vis_row = daily_df.loc[daily_df['avg_visibility'].idxmin()]
high_vis_row = daily_df.loc[daily_df['avg_visibility'].idxmax()]

low_vis_date = low_vis_row['date'].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
low_vis_value = round(low_vis_row['avg_visibility'], 1)
low_vis_pm25 = round(low_vis_row['avg_pm25'], 1)

high_vis_date = high_vis_row['date'].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
high_vis_value = round(high_vis_row['avg_visibility'], 1)
high_vis_pm25 = round(high_vis_row['avg_pm25'], 1)

print(f"\nLowest visibility day: {low_vis_date}, visibility={low_vis_value}, PM2.5={low_vis_pm25}")
print(f"Highest visibility day: {high_vis_date}, visibility={high_vis_value}, PM2.5={high_vis_pm25}")

print("=== Final Results ===")
print(f"vis_pm25_corr = {vis_pm25_corr}")
print(f"low_vis_date = {low_vis_date}")
print(f"low_vis_value = {low_vis_value}")
print(f"low_vis_pm25 = {low_vis_pm25}")
print(f"high_vis_date = {high_vis_date}")
print(f"high_vis_value = {high_vis_value}")
print(f"high_vis_pm25 = {high_vis_pm25}")
